7	---
8	
9	# Feishu Document Formatting
10	
11	## Core contract
12	
13	Format by visible content and semantic role, then mutate the **smallest complete structural block** in document order. An MCP success response is not completion; each completed mutation batch must survive read-back with tables, code, diagrams, media, and neighbors intact.
14	
15	User-explicit styling overrides defaults. Content skills decide facts; this skill controls serialization, layout, update safety, and verification.
16	
17	## Required reference
18	
19	Read [formatting rules](references/formatting-rules.md) before every write.
20	
21	## Workflow
22	
23	### 1. Fetch and classify
24	
25	Choose create, append/insert, restyle one block, replace one section, or repair malformed rich text. For an existing document, call `fetch_doc` without `limit`/`offset` to get the complete document, then locate boundaries locally. Use pagination only when the user explicitly requests it; in that case continue until the complete target block and both neighbors are available. Never infer current headings/tokens from an old draft.
26	
27	### 2. Build the structural manifest
28	
29	In document order record headings; table boundaries/shape; fenced code and Mermaid boundaries; callout/grid/container boundaries; whiteboard/image/file tokens, order, and neighbors; and target/preserve status. Do not split a table/fence/container or cross unrelated media.
30	
31	### 3. Allocate auditable widths
32	
33	Table total width matches the document's **actual text-column width**, verified so it does not overflow the adjacent callout/heading: wide-mode docs ≈ 930px, classic/narrow docs ≈ 800px. Width count equals column count and width sum equals the chosen total.
34	
35	- tiny enum/index: 70–100;
36	- status/date/version: 90–140;
37	- numeric before/after/delta: 105–145;
38	- symbol/API: 150–220;
39	- repo/code path/revision: 210–300;
40	- explanation/evidence/root cause: remaining 280–500.
41	
42	Center headers and compact values; for a user-requested uniform-centered style, center **all** cells with equal columns summing to the text width. Leave paths/prose left-aligned by omitting `align`. Vertical centering (垂直居中) is not settable via the update tool — it is a Feishu UI action (select table → 垂直居中); never claim it from a write. If the text width is insufficient for readability, split by question.
43	
44	### 4. Preflight serialization
45	
46	Check canonical same-block bold; alignment outside emphasis; balanced table/row/cell structure; equal cell count per row; balanced code/Mermaid fences; blank-line separation; container support; and punctuation locale consistency (CJK context → full-width marks, pure-ASCII context → ASCII mark + space, no mixing, code/ASCII fences exempt). Fenced code in an enhanced table cell is allowed only when its complete nested syntax has been intentionally validated; Mermaid/media/nested tables are not inserted into cells. Never write a fetched `<whiteboard token="..."/>` as creation syntax.
47	
48	### 5. Mutate in document order
49	
50	Policy for existing documents: no `overwrite` or `replace_all`. Use one unique complete-block `replace_range`; `selection_by_title` only for the exact fetched section; precise insert modes for adjacency; append only at the true end. If `selection_with_ellipsis` includes literal `...`, escape it as `\.\.\.`. Process the earliest remaining target first; one section per batch is the long-report default.
51	
52	### 6. Resolve asynchronous completion
53	
54	A mutation returning `task_id` is not a completed batch. Poll the same create/update tool with `task_id` until success/failure. Only then fetch and validate. Never begin another mutation while the preceding batch is pending.
55	
56	### 7. Enforce the read-back barrier
57	
58	After every completed batch, fetch the affected complete block and neighbors. Verify content/order; table shape/width count/sum; alignment; bold; code/Mermaid fences/language/order; container boundaries; media token/order/neighbors; warnings; and unrelated content. On failure, stop and repair only the smallest failed block, then re-run the barrier.
59	
60	## Hard rules
61	
62	- No existing-document `overwrite`/`replace_all` under this safety policy.
63	- No non-unique selection or speculative broadening.
64	- No split structural block or unrelated media crossing.
65	- No table width that overflows the document text column; match the verified text-column width (≈800 narrow, ≈930 wide).
66	- No claim that vertical centering was applied via a write (it is UI-only).
67	- No width-count/sum mismatch.
68	- No blanket centering of paths/prose.
69	- No mixed punctuation locales: CJK-context punctuation is full-width, pure-ASCII-context punctuation is ASCII + space; applies to all marks, never inside code/ASCII fences.
70	- No next batch before async completion and read-back pass.
71	- No rendering-success claim from MCP acceptance alone.
72	
73	## Final gate
74	
75	After all batch barriers, full-fetch and compare the initial manifest plus intended changes. Confirm headings, tables, fences, links, containers, media/neighbors, and warnings. Markdown read-back does not by itself prove visual font weight or final bitmap rendering; state that limit.

8	
9	# Code-grounded Visual Docs
10	
11	## Core principle
12	
13	Explain how real code behaves as **diagram-first** content, where every box, edge, branch label, threshold, and cited symbol is copied from source you actually read (with `file:line`), never guessed. Prose is the exception, not the default: prefer a fenced ASCII text-sketch, a small worked numeric example, or a compact table over any paragraph. Write into Feishu one smallest-complete-block at a time, and treat each user reply ("再形象化 / 去俚语 / 减字 / 举例 / 更细") as a scoped rewrite of exactly one block, verified by read-back.
14	
15	This skill is the orchestrator. It does not restate its siblings:
16	- **What to draw / diagram philosophy** → `diagram-first-documentation` (reader questions, fact/interpretation/limit classes, Mermaid-vs-text-sketch selection, terminology ladder, proportional budget).
17	- **How to mutate Feishu safely** → `feishu-document-formatting` (structural manifest, table widths, doc-order mutation, async completion, read-back barrier).
18	
19	Its unique contribution: **code grounding**, the **code-explanation patterns**, the **iterative block-refinement loop**, and the **edit-safety lessons** below.
20	
21	## Non-negotiables
22	
23	- **A diagram reads as authoritative.** A hand-wavy label ("size ok?", "备料", "大概") is a defect. Read the source first; label with the exact identifier or mark it unknown/interpretation.
24	- **No slang, no vague metaphor.** Ban role/action metaphors (登记员, 备料, 兜底, 命脉, 号码牌, 便宜保险). Use the precise term (请求 scratch 的函数, 计算并申请, 回退, ...). Keep standard technical terms (in-place/就地, clamp/夹取, pad/补零, broadcast/广播). Concrete rejected→accepted pairs: `references/anti-examples.md`.
25	- **Minimal text.** Replace paragraphs with a diagram, a table, or a worked example. Each diagram gets at most one one-line takeaway.
26	- **Fenced ASCII text-sketches**, not Mermaid images, when the reader needs precise inline annotation, parallel-lane/SIMD/memory layout, an AND-intersection funnel, a decision fork, a subset relation, or copy-pasteable monospace.
27	
28	## Workflow
29	
30	### 1. Ground in source before drawing
31	
32	Locate the exact code with grep/read (whole files preferred). Record for each claim the `file:line` and the exact identifier. Resolve every intended branch/threshold to source: e.g. a "capability gate" must list the real conditions; a "returns nullptr" must be traced (index out of range → `GetTensorIndex` returns -1). When authorship or intent matters, use `git blame` / `git show` and state fact vs "疑似笔误 (interpretation)". When a claim depends on data (e.g. "quantized bias is 1-D"), verify against a real artifact (inspect the model, run a compile check) rather than asserting from convention.
33	
34	### 2. Pick the encoding by information shape
35	
36	See `references/ascii-diagram-patterns.md` for the reusable catalog: dispatch/flow, AND-gate funnel, binary decision fork, two-gate subset (`{过门2} ⊆ {过门1}`), region/arena layout, ownership two-column, matrix/vector & broadcast worked example, terminology quick-reference (原语速查), and **code-snippet + one-line annotation** (quote the real loop/statement, annotate the one line that matters). Use a table only for exact parallel values or mappings; a table that actually encodes order/causality/layout is a signal to convert it to a sketch.
37	
38	### 3. Structure a code explanation as: 原语 → 判定/流程 → 数字演示
39	
40	When explaining code to a newcomer, layer it:
41	1. **原语速查 (primitives first):** draw each unfamiliar type/macro/function as a mini-sketch (enum→value table; `node->inputs` as an indexed array; a validation macro as `cond? pass : return err`), before the logic that uses it.
42	2. **判定/流程 (decision/flow):** the actual control flow built from those primitives (funnel / fork / two-gate).
43	3. **数字演示 (worked example):** run concrete numbers through it (e.g. `out_c0 = (1+0−3)+10 = 8`; a `[1,2,2,3] + [10,20,30]` broadcast expanded per channel plane). Numbers make "why" land where a formula does not.
44	
45	### 4. Write into Feishu, smallest block first
46	
47	Follow `feishu-document-formatting`. For a new doc use `create_doc`; to extend/repair use `update_doc` with a mode (`append` / `insert_before|after` / `replace_range` / `delete_range`), never `overwrite`/`replace_all` on an existing doc. Put ASCII diagrams inside ` ```plaintext ` fences; angle brackets are safe inside fences (but Feishu table cells eat `<...>` — avoid them in cells). Tables: `lark-table` with `{align="center"}` sets horizontal centering only; vertical centering is a UI action, never claim it from a write.
48	
49	### 5. Refine one block per reply
50	
51	Each feedback ("再形象化 / 去俚语 / 减字 / 举例 / 更细 / 用真实代码不要写无代码") targets one block. Locate it, `replace_range` **only that block's inner text** (keep the ` ``` ` fences), then read back. Escalate/downscale on request: "更细" → add a 原语速查 layer or a worked example; "减字" → collapse prose into a sketch; "用真实代码" → quote the actual source loop instead of describing it. When you correct a prior claim (e.g. "无代码" → "有代码，就是这段循环"), say what changed and why.
52	
53	### 6. Edit-safety (learned the hard way — see `references/edit-and-refine-loop.md`)
54	
55	- **Sequential, never parallel**, when mutating the same document. Parallel `update_doc` calls race and leave duplicated blocks ("Old content deletion failed ... duplicated content").
56	- **`selection_with_ellipsis` `...` collides with literal `...` in code** (`foo(...)`). Anchor on substrings without `...`, or escape as `\.\.\.`.
57	- **Read back after every edit** (`fetch_doc` with a `searchPhrase`): confirm balanced fences, no orphan `lark-*` tags, neighbors intact. MCP success ≠ rendered.
58	- **Concurrent human edits happen.** If a prior insertion vanished or lengths swing between fetches, the user is editing live; re-fetch, confirm stability, and stage around their blocks instead of clobbering.
59	
60	### 7. When the doc drives a code change
61	
62	If the discussion concludes in an actual source edit, keep doc and code honest: apply the edit, **compile-check** (`g++ -fsyntax-only` with the right `-D`/`-I`), verify behavior implications against a real artifact, and — for gerrit — isolate with `git worktree` on the change's current patchset base (so `refs/for/<branch>` does not drag unrelated ancestor commits), stage only the intended file, `--amend`, push. Flag behavior changes and the verification you could not run locally.
63	
64	## Hard rules
65	
66	- No un-grounded node/edge/label; no invented condition or threshold in a diagram.
67	- No slang/metaphor; no paragraph where a sketch/table/example fits.
68	- No Mermaid image when precise inline annotation or copy-pasteable monospace is required.
69	- No `overwrite`/`replace_all` on an existing doc; no parallel writes to one doc.
70	- No `...` inside an ellipsis anchor that also appears literally in the target.
71	- No claim of vertical centering, rendering, or code correctness from a write/MCP acceptance alone — read back, and for code, compile/verify.
72	
73	## Final gate
74	
75	Re-fetch the touched blocks and confirm: every diagram label traces to `file:line` or is marked interpretation/unknown; no slang; prose is minimal and each diagram carries at most one takeaway; fences balanced and no orphan table tags; tables centered horizontally only (vertical centering noted as UI-only). Scan the result against `references/anti-examples.md` — if any block matches a ❌ (metaphor label, prose-where-a-figure-fits, "无代码", 泛泛谈, 是什么/为什么 split, reflexive agreement to an imprecise claim, answer built on the user's misconception), convert it before delivering. State any claim you could not verify (rendered appearance, on-device/functional behavior) as a limit.
76

=== formatting-rules ===
# Feishu Formatting and Safe-Update Rules

## Priority

1. Preserve facts, links, structure, and unrelated rich content.
2. Follow explicit user styling.
3. Otherwise use the expert technical-report defaults.
4. Stop when uniqueness, completion, or structural integrity cannot be proven.

## Operation decision table

| Situation | Operation | Verification |
|---|---|---|
| New short document | `create_doc`; title must not repeat as first H1 | full fetch |
| New long document | create first segment, ordered append; location args remain mutually exclusive | poll task then fetch each segment |
| Replace one fetched media-free section | `replace_range` + `selection_by_title` | section + neighbors |
| Restyle one table/block | unique local `replace_range` | block + neighbors |
| Add adjacent/end content | precise insert / true-end append | boundary/tail |
| Existing broad rebuild | forbidden by this safety policy: `overwrite`, `replace_all` | n/a |
| Non-unique selection | stop and refine from fresh fetch | uniqueness first |

`wiki_node`, `wiki_space`, and `folder_token` are mutually exclusive on creation.

## Fetch and manifest

`fetch_doc` does not select by heading. By default, call it without `limit`/`offset` and fetch the complete document, then locate locally. Only when the user explicitly requests pagination may `limit`/`offset` be used; continue until the complete target block plus predecessor/successor is available. Record headings, tables, code/Mermaid fences, containers, media token/order/neighbors, and target/preserve status.

A fetched `<whiteboard token="..."/>` is read-only evidence, not creation syntax.

## Width policy

**Match the document's actual text-column width** so the table neither overflows nor looks narrow. Do not assume a fixed number: verify against a rendered reference — the table must not extend past the adjacent callout/heading right edge. Feishu wide-mode docs are ≈ **900–960px (930 typical)**; classic/narrow docs are ≈ **780–820px (800 typical)**. When a rendered table overflows, reduce the total (a one-number-per-table change) rather than assuming the default. Width count = columns, widths are positive integers, and sum = chosen total.

| Role | Typical px | Alignment |
|---|---:|---|
| index/icon/tiny enum | 70–100 | center |
| status/date/version | 90–140 | center |
| numeric/delta | 105–145 | center |
| symbol/API | 150–220 | usually left |
| repo/code path/revision | 210–300 | left |
| explanation/evidence/cause/procedure | 280–500 or remainder | left |

If 960px cannot remain readable, split by reader question. Exceed 960 only when the user explicitly overrides the default. A one-off compact/equal-width/all-left request also overrides defaults without changing future defaults.

Examples (930px):
- `类型/版本/说明`: `130,150,650`
- `状态/Change/路径/说明`: `110,140,270,410`
- `指标/前/后/变化/来源/解释`: `180,115,115,110,100,310`

### Uniform-centered style (common user request)

When the user asks for「表格总宽度 = 文本宽度、文本水平居中」or an equivalent uniform look: use **equal columns** summing to the text width and set `{align="center"}` on **every** cell (header and data). Equal-split examples — 800px: 5-col `160,160,160,160,160`, 4-col `200,200,200,200`, 3-col `266,267,267`, 2-col `400,400`; 930px: 5-col `186×5`, 4-col `232,233,232,233`, 3-col `310,310,310`.

### Alignment

Center headers and compact values with `{align="center"}`; center **all** cells for the uniform-centered style. Omit `align` for left-aligned paths/prose. Put attributes outside bold. Do not emit `{align="left"}`.

**Vertical centering (垂直居中) cannot be set through the MCP/markdown update tool** — `{align=...}` controls horizontal alignment only. Vertical alignment is a table-cell property applied in the Feishu UI (select the table → cell alignment → 垂直居中). Never claim vertical centering was applied by a write; report it as a one-click UI follow-up.

## lark-table structure

Hierarchy is `lark-table → lark-tr → lark-td`; each row has equal cells; cell content has surrounding blank lines; do not mix pipe-table syntax or nest lark-tables.

Enhanced cells may contain complex content such as a fenced code block when the complete nested structure is intentionally generated and validated. Keep ordinary technical-report code blocks outside tables by default for readability. Do not place Mermaid, media, or another lark-table inside a cell.

## Bold safety

Use paired same-block `**text**`, no inner whitespace/newline, no escaping when emphasis is intended, no split delimiters, and no changes inside code. Repair the smallest complete paragraph/list/callout/cell; never run a document-wide regex.

## Punctuation locale consistency

Match every punctuation mark to its surrounding language and never mix locales within one run. This applies to **all** punctuation (colon, comma, period, semicolon, enumeration comma `、`, brackets, quotes, exclamation/question marks, ellipsis, dash), not only colons.

- CJK context (both sides CJK, or at least one adjacent side is CJK): use full-width CJK punctuation — `：，。；、！？（）【】「」《》…——` — with no trailing ASCII space.
- Pure Latin/ASCII context (both sides are English words, numbers, code tokens, or identifiers): use the ASCII mark followed by a single space — `: ` `, ` `; ` `. ` — never a full-width mark.
- Never mix inside one clause: `实测结论:即` → `实测结论：即`; `codec-only,parser` → `codec-only, parser`; a Chinese sentence must not delimit clauses with ASCII `,`/`;`, and an all-English list must not use `，`/`；`.
- Do not alter punctuation inside fenced code blocks or ASCII diagrams — full-width marks are wider and break monospace alignment, and code content must stay byte-exact. Normalize prose, headings, callouts, blockquotes, and table cells only.
- When normalizing, edit the smallest unique block and reproduce the surrounding text (especially comment-anchored spans) exactly, so comment anchors are not orphaned.

## Fence and container safety

- Preserve matching fence and language labels.
- A selection contains the complete fence/container or none of it.
- Compare fence count, language, first/last content line, and order after each batch.
- Keep Mermaid/code outside callouts.
- Mermaid conversion warnings are failures to investigate.

## Selection safety

- `selection_by_title` replaces the complete heading section; use only after fetching and confirming that scope.
- `selection_with_ellipsis` boundaries should use 10–20 unique characters.
- Literal `...` in source must be escaped as `\.\.\.`.
- `insert_after` uses the matched range end; `insert_before` uses its start.
- Non-unique selection is a stop condition, not a reason to broaden across media.

## Ordered asynchronous batches

1. Fetch the complete document by default (or user-requested pages) and build the manifest.
2. Number targets by current document order.
3. Mutate the earliest complete block.
4. If a `task_id` returns, poll the same tool until terminal success/failure; pending is not completion.
5. Fetch the complete affected block and neighbors.
6. Validate content, table shape/width/alignment, bold, fences, containers, media, warnings, and unrelated content.
7. Only after PASS mutate the next block.
8. Finish with a full fetch and manifest comparison.

One section per batch is the long-report default. Split oversized sections only at heading/complete-block boundaries.

## Red flags

- existing-document overwrite/replace_all;
- pending task followed by another mutation or early fetch;
- non-unique or media-crossing selection;
- width count/sum mismatch, or an unverified fixed width that overflows/underfills the document text column;
- claiming vertical centering was set by a write (it is UI-only);
- blanket-centered path/prose;
- broken fence/container;
- next batch before read-back;
- changed media/fence/table count without intent;
- MCP acceptance treated as rendered success.

## 1. Dispatch / fall-through flow

Use for "try fast path, else fall back". Boxes + arrows + branch labels; put the return/condition on the edge.

```plaintext

   └────┬─────┘       └──────────────────┘

               ▼
   ┌────────────────────────┐
   │   reference_ops::Conv   │  标量兜底→标量回退（去俚语）
   └────────────────────────┘
```

## 2. AND-gate funnel

Use for "all conditions must hold to continue". List the real conditions ①②③.

```plaintext

   │  ① rank == 4                             │

   │  ③ shape 自洽 (batch/通道/bias 数对得上)   │
   └──────────┬──────────────────┬────────────┘
        任一 ✗ │            全 ✓ │
              ▼                   ▼
         enabled=false        算大小 + 申请 scratch → enabled=true
```

## 3. Binary decision fork

Use for one pointer/flag with two outcomes; hang the reasons off the failing branch.

```plaintext

          │
   ┌──────┴───────┐
 ptr 有效        ptr == 空
   │               │  ① size==0（合法）
   │               │  ② context 未实现该接口
   │               │  ③ index 非法
   ▼               ▼
 用它算          return kFallback → reference
```

## 4. Two-gate with subset relation

Use when a second, stricter gate is a subset of the first. State the set relation explicitly.

```plaintext

```

## 5. Region / arena layout

Use for bump/monotonic allocators, buffer partitions, lifetime reuse. Show a memory strip + a time axis.

```plaintext

## 一、路径 shadow 为何不成立

```plaintext
#include "Internal/arm_nn_config.h"   // arm_nn_types.h:34 / arm_nn_math_types.h:39
                 │
        GCC 引号 include 搜索顺序
                 ▼
  ① includer 自身目录 = cmsis-nn/Include/
                 │  命中 vendored Include/Internal/arm_nn_config.h
                 │  其 L54-56: #ifndef ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32 → #define ... 0
                 ▼
  ② -I / -iquote / -isystem   ← 同名 shadow 头放此处，已晚于 ①
                 │  永不参与解析
                 ▼
  唯一不改 vendored 的覆盖机制 = -include 强制前置 override 头
```

## 二、采用方案：按编译器映射 force-include

```plaintext
   override 头 arm_nn_config_override.h  →  #define ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32 1
                 │
        CMAKE_{C,CXX}_COMPILER_ID
                 │
   ┌─────────────┼──────────────┐
   GNU|Clang           IAR              其它
      │                │                 │
   -include        --preinclude     FATAL_ERROR
   (GCC/armclang)  (IAR 专用)       (未适配即 fail-loud)
```

| 编译器 | CMake 判定 | force-include flag | 覆盖工具链 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GNU / Clang | MATCHES "GNU\|Clang" | -include | arm-none-eabi-gcc / armclang AC6 |
| IAR | STREQUAL "IAR" | --preinclude | IAR iccarm（前瞻分支） |
| 其它 | else | message(FATAL_ERROR) | 未适配即 fail-loud |

## 三、代码改动（两处 CMakeLists）

apps/mlearning/cmsis-nn/CMakeLists.txt（C 目标 → CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID）：

```diff

-    cmsis_nn PRIVATE -include
-                     ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/arm_nn_config_override.h)
+  # path-shadow rejected: same Include/ tree, quoted include hits vendored first
+  if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
+    target_compile_options(cmsis_nn PRIVATE
+                           -include ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/arm_nn_config_override.h)
+  elseif(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "IAR")

+                           --preinclude ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/arm_nn_config_override.h)
+  else()
+    message(FATAL_ERROR "cmsis-nn F32 override: no force-include flag known for ${CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID}")
+  endif()
```

```diff

+  else()
+    message(FATAL_ERROR "tflite-micro F32 override: no force-include flag known for ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID}")
+  endif()
```

input.content:
# CMSIS-NN (miwear overlay)

## Source tree acquisition

`cmsis-nn/` is a repo-managed git checkout of upstream CMSIS-NN, NOT a
FetchContent download at build time. The vela CMake build consumes it
directly via `CMakeLists.txt`
(`set(CMSIS_NN_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmsis-nn)` + `target_sources`
+ `target_include_directories`). The `FetchContent_Declare` block in
`CMakeLists.txt` is a fallback that only fires if `cmsis-nn/` is absent,
which it never is in the repo-managed workspace.

- remote: `vela/apps/mlearning/cmsis-nn`
- upstream pin: `13c97dbb6f781d4aab38ed34e6e441f42b79aff4`
- tracked file: `cmsis-nn/Include/Internal/arm_nn_config.h`

## Miwear deviation: ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32 pinned to 1

Upstream `Include/Internal/arm_nn_config.h` defaults `ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32`
to `0`:

```c
#ifndef ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32
    #define ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32 0
#endif
```

Miwear changes that default to `1` directly in the vendored file (keep
the `#ifndef` guard so a command-line `-D` can still override if ever
needed):

```c
#ifndef ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32
    #define ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32 1
#endif
```

### Why a direct edit, not an override mechanism

Earlier revisions force-enabled F32 via an external override header
(`arm_nn_config_override.h`) pulled in with `-include` (GCC/Clang) /
`--preinclude` (IAR), leaving the vendored `arm_nn_config.h` untouched.
That was abandoned in favor of the direct edit because:

- **Portability.** No compiler-specific force-include flag is needed.
  `-include` (GCC/Clang) and `--preinclude` (IAR) differ, so the
  override-header route required a per-compiler `if/elseif/else` branch
  in `CMakeLists.txt` and a `FATAL_ERROR` for unknown compilers. A
  one-line default flip needs none of that.
- **No path-shadow gotcha.** A same-name shadow `arm_nn_config.h` placed
  earlier on the `-I` search path does NOT work: the includers
  (`arm_nn_types.h`, `arm_nn_math_types.h`) and
  `Internal/arm_nn_config.h` both live in the vendored `Include/` tree,
  so the quoted `#include "Internal/arm_nn_config.h"` resolves to the
  vendored copy at GCC's quoted-include step 1 (includer's own dir),
  before any `-I`/`-iquote`/`-isystem` path. Editing the vendored file
  sidesteps this entirely.
- **Simplicity.** One line in one upstream file; no extra header, no
  CMake glue, no mirror needed in `apps/mlearning/tflite-micro`.

### Consequence

Float32 kernels are always built on every core (ap, sensor, ...). The
sensor core (M33, no MVE) compiles the F32 kernels into the scalar
`#else` reference path. The F32-off build path is gone; flash grows on
cores that previously skipped F32. This is the accepted always-on
trade-off. To restore a per-core F32-off path, a per-core Kconfig
switch and source filtering would have to be reintroduced.

### Downstream effect on tflite-micro

`apps/mlearning/tflite-micro/CMakeLists.txt` previously force-included
the same override header on the `tflite_micro` target. That is no longer
needed: any tflm translation unit that includes the cmsis-nn headers sees
`ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32=1` from the vendored default, so tflm needs no
`-include` and no per-compiler branch of its own.

## Maintenance

- **Upstream rebase:** re-apply the miwear deviation by cherry-picking
  the miwear commit that flips the default, NOT by re-running a patch
  file. There is no `.patch` file for this change; it lives as a direct
  commit in the `cmsis-nn` git repo.
- **Makefile / `.patch` files are not used** by the vela CMake build.
  The legacy `Makefile` zip-unpack + patch path is gated on
  `tflite-micro/.git` existing (analogous guard) and is skipped in the
  repo-managed workspace. Do not add a `.patch` file here to override
  vendored sources; it will not be applied.
- If upstream renames or removes `ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32` from
  `arm_nn_config.h`, the miwear deviation must be re-evaluated against
  the new upstream config layout.

**How to apply:** commit 前必须 `git diff --cached <file>` 逐文件核验 staged 内容只含本工程改动;若同文件有无关 WIP,用 hunk 级 staging(`git add -p`,本环境 `-i` 受限但 `git add -p` 可用)或先编辑文件删掉 WIP 块再 add。push 前再加一道 `git show HEAD | grep -i <无关keyword>` 自检。涉及多个 patchset 的 Gerrit change,后期才发现 sweep 代价大(abend + 多次 re-push)。相关:[[miwear-f32-not-always-on]]
